agents.question: How does Low block 5-3-2 do against Possession 4-3-3 of a title contender?
agents.answer: Against a title contender playing Possession 4-3-3, Low block 5-3-2 earns 0.7 points per game on average (20 simulated matches). It concedes more chances than it creates (0.55 xG for vs 1.08 xG against).

agents.question: Que donne Gegenpress 4-2-3-1 contre Direct 4-4-2 ?
agents.answer: Le Gegenpress 4-2-3-1 contre le Direct 4-4-2 rapporte environ 1.6 point par match, sur une vingtaine de matchs simulés. Cette tactique est notre meilleure option face à cette adversité.

agents.question: How realistic is the simulator?
agents.answer: The simulator is quite realistic: it matches real football well on total stats and spatial patterns, based on 1,446 real league matches and additional tracking data.
